test_title: PYST 1: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 01 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The given sentence contains an error. Select the option that correctly rectifies the error.

The boy told his mother that he saw the most tall giraffe at the zoo.

options.text: The boy told his mother that he saw the tallest giraffe at the zoo.
The boy told his mother that he saw the most taller giraffe at the zoo.
The boy told his mother that he saw the most tallest giraffe at the zoo.
The boy told his mother that he saw the more taller giraffe at the zoo.

solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the comparative form **"most tall"** is incorrect when describing the superlative degree.
 
• For **superlative degrees** with most one-syllable adjectives, we use the ending **"-est" **instead of **"most"**.
 
• The correct superlative form of **"tall"** is "tallest", not "most tall" or any other variation.
 
• Therefore, the corrected part of the sentence should read: "he saw the tallest giraffe at the zoo."

Correct sentence: *The boy told his mother that he saw the **tallest giraffe** at the zoo.*
